test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward score loss
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing FAL, transitions, and emissions graphs then computing loss and gradients
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path by composing emissions and transitions graphs and extracting the best path labels
create_emissions_graph: create a linear emissions graph from a flat vector of probabilities with configurable time steps and classes
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target label sequence and blank token for connectionist temporal classification
